# Row 1 contains headers, so data starts from row 2.
groups = OrderedDict()

for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    student_code = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value

    if student_code is None and class_code is None:
        continue

    if student_code not in groups:
        groups[student_code] = []

        groups[student_code].append(class_code)

max_rows = end_row - start_row + 1
max_cols = end_col - start_col + 1

for r_offset, (student_code, class_codes) in enumerate(groups.items()):
    if r_offset >= max_rows:
        break

    out_row = start_row + r_offset
    values = [student_code] + class_codes

    for c_offset, value in enumerate(values[:max_cols]):
        ws.cell(row=out_row, column=start_col + c_offset).value = value
